_comment: An IBKR gateway: one process per TWS / IB Gateway login owns the API session (host:port, one client_id), the orders and the market data; the bots lease it. 'network' names which login this is — paper (DU… accounts) or live — and the gateway refuses an account id of the other kind. 'contracts' are what to list: every expiry TWS returns for a spec becomes a market (MGC/USD:USD-261229). Account 'main' takes the bare ibkr_account in gateway.env, any other name ibkr_account_<name>. 'reject_pause_s': after IBKR rejects an order on a symbol (201 / 203), its new orders are refused this many seconds (0 = off).
name: ib_paper
